findings.message: The diff updates only one of the two duplicated result-processing blocks (the select branch) to call annotateRuleConflictsForBatch; the else branch (after readyCh closes) still does `batch = kept` and never annotates. Depending on pipeline timing/scheduling, findings will be silently unannotated in one path but not the other, producing inconsistent output for identical input.
findings.suggestion: Apply the same `batch = annotateRuleConflictsForBatch(ctx, opts, p.Hunk, opts.RulesByFile[p.Hunk.FilePath], kept, annotateWarn)` replacement in the else branch (the second copy of this block) so both paths annotate identically.
